editorial_intro: Sequels rule the week — Mohanlal's Drishyam 3 lands on Prime Video, House of the Dragon returns for season three, and Colin Farrell's Sugar is back.

picks.title: Drishyam 3
picks.synopsis: Four-and-a-half years on, a wealthier but warier Georgekutty faces a fresh conspiracy engineered by Varun's father and corrupt cops who target his family. The master of misdirection must outwit them one more time.
picks.why_watch: The Malayalam original that started the franchise is back — and Mohanlal is in peak form.

picks.title: Athiradi
picks.synopsis: Tovino Thomas headlines a high-energy action comedy that mixes big set-pieces with laughs, arriving direct to streaming after its theatrical run.
picks.why_watch: Tovino doing action-comedy is exactly the breezy weekend watch you want.

picks.title: Thukra Ke Mera Pyaar Season 2
picks.synopsis: The viral revenge-romance saga returns for a second season, picking up the rags-to-riches story that made the first run a social-media sensation.
picks.why_watch: If you got hooked on the first season's drama, season two doubles down.

picks.title: Save the Tigers Season 3
picks.synopsis: The relatable Telugu comedy about married men navigating domestic chaos returns with a cosmic twist this season, keeping its slice-of-life humour intact.
picks.why_watch: One of Telugu OTT's most easygoing comfort-watches is back.

picks.title: Bhooth Bangla
picks.synopsis: A man inherits a palace in rural Mangalpur and plans his sister's wedding there, only for strange supernatural events and panicked locals to drag him into the property's mysterious past.
picks.why_watch: Priyadarshan + Akshay + Paresh Rawal — the comedy team behind Hera Pheri, doing horror-comedy.

picks.title: Karuppu
picks.synopsis: A high-octane fantasy actioner that dominated the box office now streams, blending rooted rural mythology with large-scale action.
picks.why_watch: One of the year's biggest Tamil theatrical hits, finally home.

picks.title: House of the Dragon
picks.synopsis: After a two-year wait, the Targaryen civil war escalates as season three premieres, pushing the Dance of the Dragons toward full-blown war.
picks.why_watch: The biggest fantasy series on TV is back after a long hiatus — appointment viewing.

picks.title: Sugar Season 2
picks.synopsis: Colin Farrell returns as enigmatic L.A. private investigator John Sugar, whose new case pulls him deeper into the secrets he's been hiding.
picks.why_watch: Colin Farrell's stylish, twist-loving detective is one of TV's most distinctive leads.

picks.title: The Agency Season 2
picks.synopsis: The CIA espionage drama returns as a covert officer's personal and professional loyalties collide across high-stakes international operations.
picks.why_watch: A starry, grown-up spy thriller for fans of slow-burn tradecraft.

picks.title: Voicemails for Isabelle
picks.synopsis: Grieving her sister Isabelle, Jill keeps leaving rambling voicemails on her old number — not realising a realtor named Wes now has that number, and is quietly falling for the woman behind the messages.
picks.why_watch: A sweet, funny, tear-jerking rom-com for an easy weekend night in.
